verses.1: A prayer to Asaf Elohim, the Lord. A word spoken by Him; the earth trembles from east to west.
verses.2: From Mitzion, from all the beautiful things of God, comes inspiration.
verses.3: Our God will come, and no fire will be lit before Him. Around Him, many people will be destroyed.
verses.4: It shall cry out to the heavens from above, and to the earth for its people’s judgment.
verses.5: I have gathered my righteous ones, those who have made my covenant. They are worthy of worshiping me.
verses.6: And the heavens said that they were righteous, because God had judged them fairly.
verses.7: Hear my people, and let Israel speak. I will testify against you, O God, your God! I am it.
verses.8: Not for your sacrifices or offerings do I honor you; instead, I oppose you always.
verses.9: I will not take any fruit from your gardens on the sabbath days.
verses.10: For I have all my life in the forest, among the mountains of a thousand peaks.
verses.11: I knew every corner of the mountains, and every valley where I stood.
verses.12: If I don’t tell you, it’s because I have a “Sea” and it’s full of it.
verses.13: To eat the flesh of kings and drink their blood.
verses.14: May God bless you with wisdom and protection.
verses.15: And in times of hardship, call me for I will help you and comfort you.
verses.16: And the wicked man said, “Lord, why do you want to teach laws? I have made a covenant with you.”
verses.17: And you, who are fond of lying, you spread my words around.
verses.18: If you see a thief, run away with him and with his accomplices. You shall share in their punishment.
verses.19: You have sent your evil ones; and for your sake, they will continue to deceive you.
verses.20: Sit with your brother, and speak to your mother’s son. Then you will be given food.
verses.21: These are the things you have done. I have made them into something that will be like you in appearance. I will make them worthy of your eyes.
verses.22: Let me not forget this: I must remember God, so that I won’t be destroyed and there will be no one to save me.
verses.23: The priest of the God of Israel shall anoint me and set me on the path of salvation.
